contexts.text: The produce of the lips () = doctrine.
The earth shall give its produce () = that the Celestial of the Church, or the good of charity, shall give truth.
The produce of the earth () = the like.
In the produce () = the fruit thence.
The produce (of the earth or fields) = the goods of truth thence. Illustrated. AC 9273, Explained.
The produce of the vineyard = the state of truth.
Produce = all the good and truth of the Church.
The produce of the earth = the consequent multiplication of truth.
Produce, and the foods thence, = all things which belong to spiritual nourishment.
The fruits of the sun () = all things which proceed from the Celestial Kingdom. AE 448:7.
The land shall give her increase ()... Increase = the truth of doctrine, and the understanding of truth.
The increase of the land () = the multiplication of the truth of the Church.
Fruit of increase () = goods of the Church.
Fruit = the good of charity; and increase () = the works of this good.
